source: The Aerospace Corporation, CORDS reentry database, https://aerospace.org/reentries (pages 48 and 49, sorted by predicted reentry time), read on 27 October 2026
note: Every catalogued reentry predicted between 30 July 2025 08:00 UTC and 3 August 2025 08:30 UTC, in the order the database lists them. CORDS covers tracked objects only: untracked debris would not appear, and a predicted time window is not a ground track.
